what: The section stays fixed on screen while scroll progress becomes a 0–100 timeline that steps through stages — at each stage boundary the title characters slide −110% out over the mask (3, letter gap .18), the next title characters rise from 110% below 1.2 later, the description blurs out by −8px and the next one fades in from 8px below. The stage indicator bar moves to the next cell together, and pressing a stage button scrolls to the center of that stage
